question: Can prebreakout positioning relative to the exact canonical resistance be represented as a stable parameter-free continuous feature before outcomes are joined?
mechanism: A close already positioned near the canonical prior-60 close reference may represent price acceptance before the signal session and require less one-session displacement to break out.

reference.definition: maximum action-safe adjusted close over t-60..t-1
reference.canonical_predicate: signal close t strictly exceeds the reference
reference.feature_timing: t-1, t-3, and t-5 closes are completed before the signal session
reference.available_at: before signal session; combined event artifact frozen at signal session 15:30 Asia/Shanghai

primary_feature.name: prebreakout_distance_t1
primary_feature.definition: log(adjusted close at t-1 / canonical prior-60 adjusted-close reference)
primary_feature.expected_range: non-positive because t-1 belongs to the reference window
primary_feature.interpretation: larger values, nearer zero, mean the stock was already positioned closer to resistance
primary_feature.missing_data: no imputation; incomplete or invalid action coordinates fail the experiment

neighbors.prebreakout_distance_t3: log(adjusted close at t-3 / the same canonical reference)
neighbors.prebreakout_distance_t5: log(adjusted close at t-5 / the same canonical reference)

later_controls_not_alternatives: signal displacement from t-1 to t
signal breakout margin above the canonical reference
sessions since the most recent exact reference close
frozen V1 entry state and market context

decision.FREEZE_FEATURE: all identity, PIT, exact-reconciliation, continuous-variation, temporal-neighbor, and outcome-prohibition gates pass
decision.REFINE: an outcome-blind implementation defect is diagnosed and a fresh experiment identity is justified
decision.REJECT: the parameter-free positioning feature lacks variation, exact reconstruction, or temporal-neighbor stability

forbidden: future return, MFE, MAE, false-breakout, holding, exit, winner, or loser data
choosing T-3 or T-5 from outcomes
